Replace a Table's Limits by an Inverted Test

Source: R/inference.R
invert_rows.Rd

Runs statmod_invert() on each row a restricted fit is defined for and writes the two limits back, leaving the rest of the table as it was.

Usage

invert_rows(fit, out, level, test, type)

Arguments

fit

A StatmodFit().

out

The table confint.StatmodFit() has built, already subset.

level

The confidence level.

test

Which test to invert.

type

Which variance sets the starting bracket.

Value

out with its lower and upper columns replaced.

Details

A row the restricted fit cannot hold keeps NA limits rather than the Wald ones it arrived with, so that one column never carries two different intervals. Which rows those are is testable_coords()'s answer, asked once; where it is none of them the request is refused, a table of nothing but missing values being a worse answer than the reason for it.

See also

statmod_invert(), which does the search.
